prompt: A workflow must open pull requests against a different repository it does not own. What does that require?
explanation: The `GITHUB_TOKEN` is scoped to its own repository, so cross-repository work needs credentials that live where the permissions do: a PAT or a GitHub App token granted on the target. Widening the job token cannot reach across that boundary.

options.text: A personal access token (or GitHub App token) with rights on the target repository
Nothing — any workflow can PR anywhere
